references.title: de.wikipedia: Effi Briest
references.supports: Effi von Briest, the novel's heroine

notes.rationale: The heroine's given name, so it has a Core gender (Fem, Rule de/proper-noun-article). No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root effi and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
